description: Resolve and close a support ticket (destructive, idempotent). Sets status to solved and records resolved_at. Optionally appends resolution as the final comment. If the ticket is already solved this is a no-op and returns alreadyClosed=true — do not retry. Use a real ticket_id from search_tickets or get_ticket. Use add_comment first if you want a longer explanation before closing. This is a write tool and may require a credential.

closed_by.description: Who is closing, e.g. support@example.com. Defaults to the service account.

resolution.description: Optional note appended as the final comment, e.g. Fixed by using an absolute cwd in mcp.json.

ticket_id.description: Existing ticket id from search_tickets or get_ticket. Format: TCK-1001. Do not invent an id.

name: close_ticket
